metrics.label: Success rate (class changed)
metrics.description: Fraction of eval samples where the counterfactual achieves a successful flip.

metrics.label: L2 distance (proximity)
metrics.description: Euclidean distance between original and counterfactual in pixel space.

metrics.label: Sparsity count
metrics.description: Number of pixels changed beyond a small threshold.

metrics.label: Sparsity fraction
metrics.description: Fraction of pixels changed beyond ε = 1/255.

metrics.label: P(true class) on original
metrics.description: Task classifier probability of the true label on the original image.

metrics.label: P(true class) on CF
metrics.description: Task classifier probability of the true label on the counterfactual.

metrics.label: Δ P(true class)
metrics.description: Change in true-class probability after the counterfactual edit.

metrics.label: P(intended target) on CF
metrics.description: Classifier probability of the intended target class on the CF (targeted methods).

metrics.label: P(predicted class) on CF
metrics.description: Probability of the argmax predicted class on the counterfactual.

metrics.label: Embedding dist. to source class mean
metrics.description: Squared L2 distance from CF embedding to the mean embedding of real images in the true class.

metrics.label: Embedding dist. to predicted class mean
metrics.description: Squared L2 distance from CF embedding to mean embedding of the predicted CF class.

metrics.label: LPIPS to original
metrics.description: Learned perceptual similarity vs the original image (lower = closer).

metrics.label: LPIPS to random same-class ref
metrics.description: LPIPS vs a random real image from the predicted class reference pool.

metrics.label: SSIM to original
metrics.description: Structural similarity vs original (higher = closer).

metrics.label: SSIM to random same-class ref
metrics.description: SSIM vs random reference from predicted class pool (higher = closer).

metrics.label: FID (paired orig vs CF)
metrics.description: Fréchet Inception Distance between paired originals and counterfactuals.

metrics.label: KID mean (paired orig vs CF)
metrics.description: Kernel Inception Distance mean between originals and CFs.

metrics.label: KID std (paired orig vs CF)
metrics.description: Standard deviation of KID estimate.

metrics.label: CLIP CMMD (orig vs CF distribution)
metrics.description: Gaussian-kernel MMD between CLIP embeddings of originals and CFs.

metrics.label: Batch FID vs source class pool
metrics.description: FID between CF set and stratified real images (true-class stratification).

metrics.label: Batch FID vs predicted class pool
metrics.description: FID between CF set and stratified real images (predicted-class stratification).

metrics.label: Per-sample CMMD vs source class
metrics.description: Per-CF CLIP MMD vs reference pool of the true class.

metrics.label: Per-sample CMMD vs predicted class
metrics.description: Per-CF CLIP MMD vs reference pool of the predicted CF class.

metrics.label: Stratified batch CMMD (source)
metrics.description: MMD between CF set and stratified real-image pool (true class).

metrics.label: Stratified batch CMMD (predicted)
metrics.description: MMD between CF set and stratified real-image pool (predicted class).
